verdict: Yes, with honest claims. Cosmix pitched herbal super supplements on Shark Tank India Season 3 and got a deal. Plant-based blends such as moringa, spirulina and ashwagandha are popular, but the market is crowded, so a clear use case and clean labels matter.
angle: Herbal supplement powders and capsules sell to buyers who prefer natural products. Women's health, gut health and energy are strong niches. Test for heavy metals, publish results and keep claims within the rules.
